issue.title: Project Task glossary term omits inherited sub-project blocking through parent:
issue.description:
Proposed by every bob-cli-78 phase (bob-cli-78.1 through .8) as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP, because the epic's
auto-decision memory_glossary = no forbade the edit inside the epic.

The Project Task strand says "while either blocks it, every open task in the note is Blocked and tagged
#prj_is_blocked" and links only decisions/projects-block-from-prj-line. Since bob-cli-78 that is incomplete:
a project also inherits every ancestor project's ^prj reasons through frontmatter `parent:` (recursively);
an inheriting ^prj is itself [?] and tagged #prj_is_blocked, and so is every open task in its note.

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Add one sentence: while an ancestor project (through parent:, recursively) is blocked, its ^prj and every open task in its note are Blocked and tagged #prj_is_blocked too; link [[decisions/subprojects-inherit-project-blocking]].

issue.creation_reason: All eight bob-cli-78 phases proposed this follow-up; the epic's memory_glossary=no auto-decision kept the glossary edit out of the epic.
